title: I released my first game! 🎮😁 STANDBY: A screensaver you can enter 🐬🪟
author: JayB_Official
selftext:
This is a project I've been working on with Claude and Astra the last few days on; i have a few other games I've been making but this somehow beat all of them to the door lol. 

Anyways; STANDBY is a liminal dreamcore PSX style daydream with spyro like gameplay; a procedural world that reseeds in real time if you do certain in world triggers with your dolphin mount, an end game area thats pure nostalgia and most of all just an odd vibe i love. 

I don't like to self promote at all but i was excited about this 😁

https://phaes1gaming.itch.io/standby
